title: Beyond the Grand Coalition: Simplicial Heyting Semantics and Higher-Order Coalition Capacity in the European Parliament
description: Pairwise party separation and higher-order legislative capacity need not move together. We apply simplicial Heyting semantics (SC-Logic) to European Parliament roll calls, tracking weighted Newman--Girvan party modularity and clique-based depth over thresholded co-Yes graphs. In the revised EP9 case study (2019--June 2022), modularity rises as the maximum face dimension falls at the selected local step. This is an exploratory finding: it does not identify the cause of the decline, and the location of the drop depends on the threshold mesh. Supplementary EP6 results from the 2004--2009 term, which use a legacy normalization and dimension limit, show the same direction without a comparable null test.
